1.zh: 大流士王第二年六月初一日，耶和华的话借先知哈该向犹大省长撒拉铁的儿子所罗巴伯和约撒答的儿子大祭司约书亚说：
1.en: In the second year of Darius the king, in the sixth month, in the first day of the month, the LORD’s word came by Haggai the prophet, to Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, saying,

1.zh: 万军之耶和华如此说：「这百姓说，建造耶和华殿的时候尚未来到。」
1.en: “This is what the LORD of Armies says: These people say, ‘The time hasn’t yet come, the time for the LORD’s house to be built.’”

1.zh: 那时耶和华的话临到先知哈该说：
1.en: Then the LORD’s word came by Haggai the prophet, saying,

1.zh: 「这殿仍然荒凉，你们自己还住天花板的房屋吗？
1.en: “Is it a time for you yourselves to dwell in your paneled houses, while this house lies waste?

1.zh: 现在万军之耶和华如此说：你们要省察自己的行为。
1.en: Now therefore this is what the LORD of Armies says: ‘Consider your ways.

1.zh: 你们撒的种多，收的却少；你们吃，却不得饱；喝，却不得足；穿衣服，却不得暖；得工钱的，将工钱[装]在破漏的囊中。」
1.en: You have sown much, and bring in little. You eat, but you don’t have enough. You drink, but you aren’t filled with drink. You clothe yourselves, but no one is warm; and he who earns wages earns wages to put them into a bag with holes in it.’

1.zh: 万军之耶和华如此说：「你们要省察自己的行为。
1.en: “This is what the LORD of Armies says: ‘Consider your ways.

1.zh: 你们要上山取木料，建造这殿，我就因此喜乐，且得荣耀。这是耶和华说的。
1.en: Go up to the mountain, bring wood, and build the house. I will take pleasure in it, and I will be glorified,” says the LORD.

1.zh: 你们盼望多得，所得的却少；你们收到家中，我就吹去。这是为什么呢？因为我的殿荒凉，你们各人却顾自己的房屋。这是万军之耶和华说的。
1.en: “You looked for much, and, behold, it came to little; and when you brought it home, I blew it away. Why?” says the LORD of Armies, “Because of my house that lies waste, while each of you is busy with his own house.

1.zh: 所以为你们的缘故，天就不降甘露，地也不出土产。
1.en: Therefore for your sake the heavens withhold the dew, and the earth withholds its fruit.

1.zh: 我命干旱临到地土、山冈、五谷、新酒，和油，并地上的出产、人民、牲畜，以及人手一切劳碌得来的。」
1.en: I called for a drought on the land, on the mountains, on the grain, on the new wine, on the oil, on that which the ground produces, on men, on livestock, and on all the labor of the hands.”

1.zh: 那时，撒拉铁的儿子所罗巴伯和约撒答的儿子大祭司约书亚，并剩下的百姓，都听从耶和华—他们　神的话和先知哈该奉耶和华—他们　神差来所说的话；百姓也在耶和华面前存敬畏的心。
1.en: Then Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel and Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, with all the remnant of the people, obeyed the LORD their God’s voice, and the words of Haggai the prophet, as the LORD their God had sent him; and the people feared the LORD.

1.zh: 耶和华的使者哈该奉耶和华差遣对百姓说：「耶和华说：我与你们同在。」
1.en: Then Haggai, the LORD’s messenger, spoke the LORD’s message to the people, saying, “I am with you,” says the LORD.

1.zh: 耶和华激动犹大省长撒拉铁的儿子所罗巴伯和约撒答的儿子大祭司约书亚，并剩下之百姓的心，他们就来为万军之耶和华—他们　神的殿做工。
1.en: The LORD stirred up the spirit of Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and the spirit of Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and the spirit of all the remnant of the people; and they came and worked on the house of the LORD of Armies, their God,

1.zh: 这是在大流士王第二年六月二十四日。
1.en: in the twenty-fourth day of the month, in the sixth month, in the second year of Darius the king.

2.zh: 七[月]二十一[日]，耶和华的话临到先知哈该说：
2.en: In the seventh month, in the twenty-first day of the month, the LORD’s word came by Haggai the prophet, saying,

2.zh: 「你要晓谕犹大省长撒拉铁的儿子所罗巴伯和约撒答的儿子大祭司约书亚，并剩下的百姓，说：
2.en: “Speak now to Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and to the remnant of the people, saying,

2.zh: 你们中间存留的，有谁见过这殿从前的荣耀呢？现在你们看着如何？岂不在眼中看如无有吗？」
2.en: ‘Who is left among you who saw this house in its former glory? How do you see it now? Isn’t it in your eyes as nothing?

2.zh: 耶和华说：「所罗巴伯啊，虽然如此，你当刚强！约撒答的儿子大祭司约书亚啊，你也当刚强！这地的百姓，你们都当刚强做工，因为我与你们同在。这是万军之耶和华说的。
2.en: Yet now be strong, Zerubbabel,’ says the LORD. ‘Be strong, Joshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest. Be strong, all you people of the land,’ says the LORD, ‘and work, for I am with you,’ says the LORD of Armies.

2.zh: 这是[照着]你们出埃及我与你们立约的话。那时，我的灵住在你们中间，你们不要惧怕。」
2.en: This is the word that I covenanted with you when you came out of Egypt, and my Spirit lived among you. ‘Don’t be afraid.’

2.zh: 万军之耶和华如此说：「过不多时，我必再一次震动天地、沧海，与旱地。
2.en: For this is what the LORD of Armies says: ‘Yet once more, it is a little while, and I will shake the heavens, the earth, the sea, and the dry land;

2.zh: 我必震动万国；万国的珍宝必都运来，我就使这殿满了荣耀。这是万军之耶和华说的。」
2.en: and I will shake all nations. The treasure of all nations will come, and I will fill this house with glory, says the LORD of Armies.

2.zh: 万军之耶和华说：「银子是我的，金子也是我的。
2.en: The silver is mine, and the gold is mine,’ says the LORD of Armies.

2.zh: 这殿后来的荣耀必大过先前的荣耀；在这地方我必赐平安。这是万军之耶和华说的。」
2.en: ‘The latter glory of this house will be greater than the former,’ says the LORD of Armies; ‘and in this place I will give peace,’ says the LORD of Armies.”

2.zh: 大流士王第二年九[月]二十四[日]，耶和华的话临到先知哈该说：
2.en: In the twenty-fourth day of the ninth month, in the second year of Darius, the LORD’s word came by Haggai the prophet, saying,

2.zh: 万军之耶和华如此说：「你要向祭司问律法，
2.en: “The LORD of Armies says: Ask now the priests concerning the law, saying,

2.zh: 说：若有人用衣襟兜圣肉，这衣襟挨着饼，或汤，或酒，或油，或别的食物，便算为圣吗？」祭司说：「不算为圣。」
2.en: ‘If someone carries holy meat in the fold of his garment, and with his fold touches bread, stew, wine, oil, or any food, will it become holy?’” The priests answered, “No.”

2.zh: 哈该又说：「若有人因摸死尸染了污秽，然后挨着这些物的哪一样，这物算污秽吗？」祭司说：「必算污秽。」
2.en: Then Haggai said, “If one who is unclean by reason of a dead body touches any of these, will it be unclean?” The priests answered, “It will be unclean.”

2.zh: 于是哈该说：「耶和华说：这民这国，在我面前也是如此；他们手下的各样工作都是如此；他们在坛上所献的也是如此。」
2.en: Then Haggai answered, “‘So is this people, and so is this nation before me,’ says the LORD; ‘and so is every work of their hands. That which they offer there is unclean.

2.zh: 现在你们要追想，此日以前，耶和华的殿没有一块石头垒在石头上的光景。
2.en: Now, please consider from this day and backward, before a stone was laid on a stone in the LORD’s temple.

2.zh: 在那一切日子，有人来到[谷]堆，想得二十[斗]，只得了十[斗]。有人来到酒池，想得五十[桶]，只得了二十[桶]。
2.en: Through all that time, when one came to a heap of twenty measures, there were only ten. When one came to the wine vat to draw out fifty, there were only twenty.

2.zh: 在你们手下的各样工作上，我以旱风、霉烂、冰雹攻击你们，你们仍不[归向]我。这是耶和华说的。
2.en: I struck you with blight, mildew, and hail in all the work of your hands; yet you didn’t turn to me,’ says the LORD.

2.zh: 你们要追想此日以前，就是从这九月二十四日起，追想到立耶和华殿根基的日子。
2.en: ‘Consider, please, from this day and backward, from the twenty-fourth day of the ninth month, since the day that the foundation of the LORD’s temple was laid, consider it.

2.zh: 仓里有谷种吗？葡萄树、无花果树、石榴树、橄榄树都没有结果子。从今日起，我必赐福[与你们]。
2.en: Is the seed yet in the barn? Yes, the vine, the fig tree, the pomegranate, and the olive tree haven’t produced. From today I will bless you.’”

2.zh: 这月二十四日，耶和华的话二次临到哈该说：
2.en: The LORD’s word came the second time to Haggai in the twenty-fourth day of the month, saying,

2.zh: 「你要告诉犹大省长所罗巴伯说：我必震动天地。
2.en: “Speak to Zerubbabel, governor of Judah, saying, ‘I will shake the heavens and the earth.

2.zh: 我必倾覆列国的宝座，除灭列邦的势力，并倾覆战车和坐在其上的。马必跌倒，骑马的败落，各人被弟兄的刀所杀。
2.en: I will overthrow the throne of kingdoms. I will destroy the strength of the kingdoms of the nations. I will overthrow the chariots and those who ride in them. The horses and their riders will come down, everyone by the sword of his brother.

2.zh: 万军之耶和华说：我仆人撒拉铁的儿子所罗巴伯啊，到那日，我必以你为印，因我拣选了你。这是万军之耶和华说的。」
2.en: In that day, says the LORD of Armies, I will take you, Zerubbabel my servant, the son of Shealtiel,’ says the LORD, ‘and will make you like a signet ring, for I have chosen you,’ says the LORD of Armies.”
